title: Can I SURVIVE Paradigm Chess?
summary: The creator plays Paradigm Chess (Paradigm30) online against much higher-rated humans, aiming for three wins. Bishops are replaced by Dragons that move like a bishop plus a NON-jumping knight (the knight move is traced one square orthogonally then one diagonally outward, so it can be blocked). Starting positions are scrambled Chess960-style. He loses game 2 but wins games 1, 3 and 4.
rules: Bishops are replaced by Dragon Bishops: moves as a bishop OR as a knight that cannot jump (the knight leap is blocked if the orthogonally-adjacent square on its path is occupied: 'one square orthogonally and then any of the diagonal squares').
Back-rank piece order is scrambled (Chess960-style random start; mirrored for both sides).
Normal checkmate rules; castling allowed as in 960 (he mentions castling no longer an option after king moves).
win_condition: Checkmate. Goal: 3 wins vs higher-rated humans.
